name: Communication Icon
author: Mehmet Salih KARACA

sections.description:
Easy-to-Use Communication Button

The Communication Icon plugin allows you to add a customizable contact button to your WordPress website.
Visitors can use the button to contact you via WhatsApp or other platforms directly.

Key Features:
– Lightweight and fast for any WordPress theme.
– Fully customizable button icon and phone number.
– Add custom CSS for further styling.
– Seamless integration with your site layout.

Created by: Mehmet Salih Karaca

sections.installation:
1. Upload the communication-icon folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Communication Icon to configure the plugin (icon URL, phone number, custom CSS).
sections.faq:
How do I customize the button’s icon and phone number?

Go to Settings > Communication Icon in the WordPress admin panel to edit the button’s details.

Can I style the button with my own CSS?

Yes, the settings page allows you to add custom CSS that will be applied directly to the button.
